column1: EU Green-Transition Regulatory Intermediaries — Final Three-Case Dataset
Researcher-adjudicated dataset using a multi-level R-I-T architecture: Act/Regime → Actor-in-Role → Intermediary Function/Mechanism, supported by relation-level evidence.

column2: Defines the legal and institutional context of each regulation.
Maps actors as R, I or T within each act; roles remain relational and context-dependent.
Preserves the operative legal episodes that justify role and intermediary classifications.
Formal reporting or evidence transmission used as part of the regulatory mechanism.
Certification/licensing/accreditation functions that validate actors or compliance status.
Independent verification/assurance of regulated information or performance.
Institutionally integrated intermediary functions outside the four focal families (e.g., comitology, expert consultation, border-information functions).
No final instance identified in these three acts.
